description: RLM Skill - Recursive Language Model pattern for processing large inputs using Sonnet orchestrator and parallel Haiku subagents

userStories.title: Create RLM skill directory and SKILL.md with core workflow
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the RLM skill created with directory structure and SKILL.md containing the full decompose-process-synthesize workflow so Claude can process large inputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Directory created at .claude/skills/rlm/
SKILL.md has valid YAML frontmatter with name: rlm
YAML description includes trigger keywords: analyze large, recursive analysis, deep analysis, process large input, comprehensive review, rlm, recursive reasoning
SKILL.md contains purpose statement explaining the RLM pattern
SKILL.md contains Prerequisites section (Task tool access, scratchpad directory)
SKILL.md contains Step 1: Assess Task Complexity with size thresholds (>50 files or >10K lines or >100K tokens triggers RLM, otherwise process directly)

SKILL.md contains Step 2: Decompose the Problem with 3 strategies: uniform chunking (split by ~200 lines), keyword filtering (use Grep to narrow), structural decomposition (parse sections/functions/headings)
SKILL.md contains decision criteria for choosing between the 3 strategies based on input type and query type
SKILL.md contains chunk size guidance: target ~200 lines or ~8K tokens per chunk with 5-10 lines overlap
SKILL.md contains Step 3: Spawn Worker Sub-Agents with Task tool invocation pattern explicitly specifying model: haiku and subagent_type: general-purpose
SKILL.md contains Step 4: Evaluate Completeness with convergence criteria (completeness >= 90% AND confidence >= 80%, max 3 iterations)
SKILL.md contains iterative deepening pattern: if gaps found, re-decompose and spawn new Haiku batch (workaround for no-nesting constraint)
SKILL.md contains Step 5: Synthesize Final Output with aggregation and deduplication instructions
SKILL.md explicitly states model selection: Sonnet for supervisor (decomposition + synthesis), Haiku for workers (chunk processing)
All instructions use imperative form (Analyze, Decompose, Spawn, not You should analyze)
SKILL.md is under 5000 words
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is the main skill file. Read existing skills at .claude/skills/reflection/SKILL.md and .claude/skills/prd/SKILL.md for patterns. Read expert analyses at .claude/plans/plan-rlm-skill/ for detailed design guidance.

userStories.title: Add error handling, fallback patterns, and model selection guidance to SKILL.md
userStories.description: As Claude, I need error handling instructions and clear model routing rules in the skill so I can recover gracefully from failures.
acceptanceCriteria: SKILL.md contains Error Handling section
Single subagent failure: retry once with same prompt
Multiple failures (>30% of chunks): fall back to Sonnet-only processing
All failures: process entire input directly with Sonnet without chunking
Partial results: produce output noting gaps and completeness percentage
Graceful degradation ladder documented: Full RLM -> Partial -> Sonnet fallback -> Best-effort
SKILL.md contains Model Selection section with table: Sonnet for decomposition/synthesis, Haiku for chunk processing
SKILL.md contains When NOT to Use RLM section (small inputs <500 lines, single file, simple queries)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Edit the SKILL.md created in US-001. Add these sections after the main workflow steps.

userStories.title: Add 3 realistic example scenarios to SKILL.md
userStories.description: As Claude, I need concrete examples showing the RLM pattern applied to real tasks so I understand the expected workflow end-to-end.
acceptanceCriteria: SKILL.md contains Examples section with 3 scenarios
Example 1: Comprehensive codebase security review - 150 files split into 5 module-based chunks, parallel Haiku analysis, synthesized security report with findings by severity
Example 2: Long document analysis - 80-page paper split into section-based chunks, extract key findings per section, unified summary
Example 3: Multi-file question answering - trace auth flow across 30+ files, layer-based chunks (frontend/API/backend/database), end-to-end trace output
Each example shows all 3 phases: Decomposition plan, Processing (Task tool calls with model: haiku), Synthesis
Examples demonstrate model routing: Sonnet for strategy and synthesis, Haiku for chunks
Each example shows the user request and the expected output format
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Edit the SKILL.md created in US-001. Add Examples section. Keep examples concise but complete - show the workflow not just the result.

userStories.title: Create references/prompt-templates.md with Haiku subagent templates
userStories.description: As Claude, I need reusable prompt templates for spawning Haiku chunk-processing subagents so I can maintain consistency across RLM invocations.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at .claude/skills/rlm/references/prompt-templates.md
Contains extraction prompt template: for pulling specific information from chunks (findings, positions, confidence)
Contains analysis prompt template: for analyzing chunks against a query (claims, evidence, caveats)
Contains filtering prompt template: for determining chunk relevance (relevance score 0-1, key passages, INCLUDE/SKIP action)
Contains synthesis prompt template: for final Sonnet aggregation (integrate findings, resolve contradictions, cite sources)
All templates are self-contained: include placeholders for original query, chunk content, chunk number/total, output format
All templates specify structured output format with findings, confidence, and cross-references
All chunk templates include constraint: Focus ONLY on this chunk, do NOT reference external content
All chunk templates specify model: haiku in usage notes
Synthesis template specifies model: sonnet in usage notes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Create the references/ subdirectory and prompt-templates.md. These templates are loaded contextually by Claude when the RLM skill is active.

userStories.title: Create install.sh script for standalone skill installation
userStories.description: As a developer who finds this skill on GitHub, I want a single install.sh script so I can download and install the RLM skill into any project without cloning the entire Orchestra repo.
acceptanceCriteria: Script created at .claude/skills/rlm/install.sh
Script is executable (chmod +x)
Script creates .claude/skills/rlm/ directory in the current project by default
Script supports --global flag to install to ~/.claude/skills/rlm/ instead
Script downloads SKILL.md and references/prompt-templates.md from the repo raw GitHub URLs (use https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ruska-ai/orchestra/master/.claude/skills/rlm/ as base URL)
Script validates that both files were downloaded successfully and are non-empty
Script prints success message with usage instructions after install (e.g. 'RLM skill installed. Trigger with: analyze large, recursive analysis, rlm')
Script is idempotent — running again overwrites existing files without error
Script includes header comment with one-liner usage: curl -fsSL <raw-url>/install.sh | bash
Script uses set -e for error handling
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use raw.githubusercontent.com URLs for the ruska-ai/orchestra repo. The script should be simple — mkdir, curl, validate, print. Check .claude/skills/agent-browser/ or similar for any existing install patterns.
